Apply an update (e.g., from tbl_diff2) to a snapshot

Source: R/patch.R
tbl_patch.Rd

Apply an update (e.g., from tbl_diff2) to a snapshot

Usage

tbl_patch(snapshot, update, ukey_names)

Arguments

snapshot

tibble or NULL; entire data set as of some version, or NULL to treat update as the initial version of the data set.

update

tibble; ukeys + initial values for added rows, ukeys + new values for changed rows. Deletions must be imprecisely represented as changing all values to NAs.

ukey_names

character; names of columns that should form a unique key for snapshot and for update. Uniqueness is unchecked; if you don't have this guaranteed, see check_ukey_unique().

Value

tibble; snapshot of the data set with the update applied.
